verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ عَلَى «ذَوَاتِ ٱلنَّفْخِ». مَزْمُورٌ لِدَاوُدَ لِكَلِمَاتِي أَصْغِ يَارَبُّ. تَأَمَّلْ صُرَاخِي.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Nehiloth, A Psalm of David. Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David. Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.

verses.ar: ٱسْتَمِعْ لِصَوْتِ دُعَائِي يَا مَلِكِي وَإِلَهِي، لِأَنِّي إِلَيْكَ أُصَلِّي.
verses.kjv: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.
verses.web: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.

verses.ar: يَارَبُّ، بِٱلْغَدَاةِ تَسْمَعُ صَوْتِي. بِٱلْغَدَاةِ أُوَجِّهُ صَلَاتِي نَحْوَكَ وَأَنْتَظِرُ.
verses.kjv: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct [my prayer] unto thee, and will look up.
verses.web: Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ لَسْتَ إِلَهًا يُسَرُّ بِٱلشَّرِّ، لَا يُسَاكِنُكَ ٱلشِّرِّيرُ.
verses.kjv: For thou [art] not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
verses.web: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.

verses.ar: لَا يَقِفُ ٱلْمُفْتَخِرُونَ قُدَّامَ عَيْنَيْكَ. أَبْغَضْتَ كُلَّ فَاعِلِي ٱلْإِثْمِ.
verses.kjv: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
verses.web: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

verses.ar: تُهْلِكُ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّمِينَ بِٱلْكَذِبِ. رَجُلُ ٱلدِّمَاءِ وَٱلْغِشِّ يَكْرَهُهُ ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
verses.web: You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَبِكَثْرَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ أَدْخُلُ بَيْتَكَ. أَسْجُدُ فِي هَيْكَلِ قُدْسِكَ بِخَوْفِكَ.
verses.kjv: But as for me, I will come [into] thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: [and] in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
verses.web: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

verses.ar: يَارَبُّ، ٱهْدِنِي إِلَى بِرِّكَ بِسَبَبِ أَعْدَائِي. سَهِّلْ قُدَّامِي طَرِيقَكَ.
verses.kjv: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
verses.web: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي أَفْوَاهِهِمْ صِدْقٌ. جَوْفُهُمْ هُوَّةٌ. حَلْقُهُمْ قَبْرٌ مَفْتُوحٌ. أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ صَقَلُوهَا.
verses.kjv: For [there is] no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part [is] very wickedness; their throat [is] an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
verses.web: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

verses.ar: دِنْهُمْ يَا ٱللهُ! لِيَسْقُطُوا مِنْ مُؤَامَرَاتِهِمْ. بِكَثْرَةِ ذُنُوبِهِمْ طَوِّحْ بِهِمْ، لِأَنَّهُمْ تَمَرَّدُوا عَلَيْكَ.
verses.kjv: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
verses.web: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

verses.ar: وَيَفْرَحُ جَمِيعُ ٱلْمُتَّكِلِينَ عَلَيْكَ. إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ يَهْتِفُونَ، وَتُظَلِّلُهُمْ. وَيَبْتَهِجُ بِكَ مُحِبُّو ٱسْمِكَ.
verses.kjv: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
verses.web: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ تُبَارِكُ ٱلصِّدِّيقَ يَارَبُّ. كَأَنَّهُ بِتُرْسٍ تُحِيطُهُ بِٱلرِّضَا.
verses.kjv: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as [with] a shield.
verses.web: For you will bless the righteous. Yahweh, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
